```{r}
# 320.035s
# Copyright (c) 2025 Dongdong Kong. All rights reserved.
source('scripts/main_pkgs.R')
devtools::load_all()

# read output of ModernHydroModels
read_output <- function(indir) {
  fs <- dir2(indir, "Output.*.csv")
  map(fs, fread) %>% rbindlist()
}

sites <- c("松柏（二）", "县河", "房县", "延坝", "孤山")
root <- "/mnt/z/GitHub/jl-pkgs/ModernHydroModels.jl" %>% path.mnt()

# indir = glue("{dir_root}/Project_Shiyan2025/OUTPUT/version1_千里眼/")
dir_root <- glue("{root}/Project_Shiyan2025/OUTPUT/version3_洪水摘录表_OnlyEvents")

run_xgb <- function(model, overwrite=FALSE) {
  outdir = "./OUTPUT/V20260603/"
  fout <- glue("{outdir}/res_{model}.rda")
  (isfile(fout) && !overwrite) && return()

  indir = glue("{dir_root}/{model}")
  df <- read_output(indir) %>% merge(forcing) # [site, time, P, Q_obs, Q_sim, PET_FAO98, PET_PT1972, PET_Romanenko]

  print(model)
  res <- map(seq_along(sites), function(i) {
    SITE = sites[i]
    fprintf("[%d] %s \n", i, SITE)

    data_full <- df[site == SITE, ] # %>% add_previous()
    # t0 = make_datetime(2023, 12, 31, 23, 59, 59)
    year_end = max(data_full[!is.na(Q_obs), year(time)]) - 1 #

    data_calib <- data_full[year(time) < year_end]
    data_valid <- data_full[year(time) >= year_end]
    xgb <- train_xgboost(data_calib)

    calib <- summary_xgboost(xgb, data_calib) # 率定期(样本内): newdata=NULL 用训练数据
    valid <- summary_xgboost(xgb, data_valid) # 验证期(样本外)
    listk(data_full, xgb, calib, valid)
  }) %>% set_names(sites)
  save(res, file = fout)
}

##
model = MODELS[5]
SITE <- sites[2]
```

## 分析表现

```{r}
# 然后对这个结果进行绘图
models <- c("Hydro", "MetXGB", "QlagXGB", "HydroMetXGB", "HydroMetQlagXGB")
gof = valid$gof %>% 
  mutate(
    model = factor(model, levels = models), 
    lead = as.integer(str_extract(lead, "\\d+")),
  ) %>% arrange(model, lead) %>% 
  filter(kfold %in% c("-", "mean"))
```
